'''Corin Ayellin''' is an [[Emond's Field]] resident.

==Appearance==
She is a slim woman with a gray braid that goes to her waist.

==History==
When [[Nynaeve al'Meara]] was sixteen, [[Nela Thane]] dared her to steal a plum pudding from Mistress Ayellin. When Mistress Ayellin caught her, she gave Nynaeve a "whipping."{{ref/book|5|55}} When the men are shearing sheep, she helps bring them food. She is thought of as being one of the best cooks in Emond's Field, her specialty being sweets.{{ref/book|1|ravens}}

==Activities==
Mistress Ayellin had a fever that Nynaeve was tending.{{ref/book|1|3}} During Nynaeve's testing for [[Accepted]], she saw Mistress Ayellin as part of the [[Women's Circle]].{{ref/book|2|23}} When [[Cenn Buie]] does a poor job on the thatching on her house, she tries to get him to fix it.{{ref/book|4|30}}
